venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CC ATL — Tuesday 8/11.** MOD Jk/MKZ. Net $2,231 vs $2,146 target (+4.0%). Food $642. 74 guests / $30.15 check avg. Comps $92.10. A great & rainy Bingo Tuesday — weather wasn't on our side early but that didn't stop faces from showing up. Bingo started at 6pm with Jess and the space filled with good vibes soon after; she has become a staple of Bingo. Opener left around 7pm; calm but consistent flow of guests until 9pm. Barback handled prep as usual and came out to help close down; MOD and bartender handled guests. Smooth end to night. Kitchen: busy night for food, great job. Favorite moment: seeing everyone excited for bingo. Entered by Mya.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Tuesday 8/11.** MOD MD / Chef JMS. Net $1,155 vs $1,549 target (-25.4%). Food $223. 38 guests / $30.39 check avg. Comps $18 (1.5%; manager, industry, residents). Down-tempo Tuesday bingo night — familiar faces plus mostly newcomers, some staying to play for a couple hours. Brief pop ~10:15pm that faded to industry regulars by 11:30. Resident Brandon (modified Eastsides) tried the loaded dog and jojos — a hit. Ended the night with Graham and Sienna from Optimist. Kitchen: John Michael held it down while training DM. 86'd: Los Monteros, Pandra, Rose; low tonic. Favorite moment: a plurality of first dates during service.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Tuesday 8/11.** AM Carey & Josh; PM Maggie H & Rachel. Net $8,713.21 vs $8,154 target (+6.9%) — fourth straight night hitting goal. DC/AM $705.58, D&C PM $8,007.63. Food $2,015.70. 258 guests (Tock). Comps $416.16. Gloomy, rainy Denver day; slow until the 8pm pop hit early alongside IRDs — some scrambling but the team made it through. Labor 30.1% of net, a touch high. AM smooth (need Toast button for peach cardi tea; 86 sparkling Saratoga, low evergreen syrup). Kitchen: chill prep day, a few 911s (cola onions, chicken breast, pasta, rabbit braise); 86 chicken breast. Maintenance: several outlets in the Garden and kitchen stopped working (logged in maintenance channel).

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Tuesday 8/11.** MOD Steve's + Kyler. Net $3,979 vs $3,581 target (+11.1%); D&C excl events $2,259 + $1,720 events. Food $631 / beverage $1,723. 98 guests / $40 check avg. Comps $125 (industry and family love). Hot, densely humid night — slower start, then a solid 7pm reservation block built momentum into a steady evening; small waitlist for 2s through the 8–9pm wave, cleared by 10:30. Marielle's (MM) last night — emotional send-off, her husband and industry friends (Seth from Bateman's, Frank Schael) came through. 5 birthdays. Top sellers: Native Lion, Rosalie, High Plains Drifter, gin martinis. One no-show (Colin Wilkinson, 2 at 10pm), not charged. Menu count 18.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Tuesday 8/11.** MOD Joe + Vic. Net $4,061 vs $4,342 target (-6.5%). Food $743. 109 guests; avg order $79.84 per report. Comps $107 (chef from Camphor, Joe's old coworker, Britney from Namari, birthday, DNL). Mellow Tuesday — sleepy first couple hours used for deep cleaning; Ariana trained at the host stand and did an amazing job. Room filled ~9pm with a consistent walk-in flow, a couple of 4-tops in the 20s, then a smooth final hour with familiar industry faces for post-work drinks. No-shows charged. Favorite moment: a Capitol Records employee bought three Capitol Records mugs.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.weather: Hot to start, turned into a nice evening
venues.narrative: **DC — Tuesday 8/11.** MOD Marcus. Net $4,085.06 vs $3,861 target (+5.8%). Marquee bar sales $4,501.88; food $397.80. 85 guests (68 walk-in / 17 reso, SevenRooms; Toast 103) / $48.06 check avg. Comps $38.48 (investor $12.48, service recovery $26). What a Tuesday! Fairly typical until 8:30pm with two-tops and a seven-top; Chaz did a fantastic job on his first solo hosting shift and was cut around 8:30 — immediately followed by a rush: a wave of guests around 9pm including an unexpected 20-top in town for a convention. Despite a skeleton crew the team communicated, supported one another, and delivered great hospitality through the rush. Shout-out to Rasaan on his first kitchen training shift — strong first impression. Operational reminder: consistently use the KDS — every ticket acknowledged and fulfilled through it. Favorite moment: Jonathan Feuersanger surprising us with a visit. Entered by Marcus.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Pleasant day; very hot afternoon/evening with light rain showers
venues.narrative: **MG — Tuesday 8/11.** AM Sam & Shannon; PM James & Marcus. Net $4,028 vs $4,500 target (-10.5%). Municipal Bar AM $1,191 / PM $2,429; Sun Club $408; Hot Eye closed. Food $1,858. 67 guests (10 AM + 57 PM, OpenTable). Comps $121. Morning busier than yesterday — hotel-group traffic providing daytime action. Evening very quiet at Municipal Bar; small end-of-night pop from a tour group and hotel guests. Sun Club: slushy machine back (frozen Hugo needs a rebatch after troubleshooting); work-trip group ran on Aperol spritzes. Kitchen clean — nothing 86'd. Maintenance: prep-kitchen and east-basement toilets need immediate attention (possible battery/sensor reset). Favorite moment: David Little and Savannah Distributing managers staying in the hotel this week.
